description: This file defines interfaces, macros, enums, and function prototypes for the GSM AMR encoder library, including initialization, reset, exit, and encoding functions, as well as constants related to the AMR codec.

methods.name: AMREncodeInit
methods.description: Initializes the GSM AMR encoder library, setting up encoder and sid_sync structures.

methods.name: AMREncodeReset
methods.description: Resets the state memory used by the encoder and SID sync.

methods.name: AMREncodeExit
methods.description: Frees up the memory used by the encoder and SID sync structures.

methods.name: AMREncode
methods.description: Encodes raw speech data into a bitstream in specified format (WMF, IF2, or ETS).
